Interface CargoHandlerCard

All Known Implementing Classes:
AbandonedStationCard, PlanetsCard, SmugglersCard
public interface CargoHandlerCard
Interface for cards that allow a player to manage cargo during a card event.

  • Method Details

    • loadCargo

      void loadCargo(Player player, int blockIndex, Point tileCoords, int containerIndex)
      Loads a cargo block from the temporary pool to a specified container on the player's ship.
      Parameters:
      player - the player performing the action
      blockIndex - index of the cargo block in the temporary cargo pool
      tileCoords - coordinates of the tile where the cargo is being placed
      containerIndex - index of the cargo container on the target tile

    • unloadCargo

      void unloadCargo(Player caller, Point tileCoords, int containerIndex)
      Unloads a cargo block from a container on the player's ship back to the temporary pool.
      Parameters:
      caller - the player performing the action
      tileCoords - coordinates of the tile from which the cargo is being removed
      containerIndex - index of the cargo container being emptied

    • confirmDone

      void confirmDone(Player caller)
      Confirms that the player has finished loading/unloading cargo.
      Parameters:
      caller - the player who is done with cargo management
